data.name: Derby Champions
data.detailed_description:
Breed champions. Train legends. Win the biggest races.

In Derby Champions, you build your own racing dynasty from the ground up. Breed powerful bloodlines, train your horses to peak performance, and compete against players from around the world in thrilling online races.

Every horse has unique genetics, stats, and potential. Will you create the next legendary champion?

Raise your stable, dominate the track, and prove your horses are the fastest in the world.

🐎 Breed the Next Champion

Build powerful bloodlines by breeding horses with unique genetics and traits. Experiment with different pairings to discover rare horses, superior stats, and special combinations that could produce the ultimate racer.

🏇 Train and Develop Your Horses

Every champion starts somewhere. Train your horses to improve their speed, stamina, and racing performance as they grow into elite competitors ready for the biggest events.

🌎 Compete in Online Multiplayer Races

Race against players from around the world in a variety of events:

  • Normal Races – Build experience and earn prize money

  • Special Races – Tougher competition with bigger rewards

  • Championship Races – High-stakes events where legends are made

Only the best horses will rise to the top.

🏠 Build and Customize Your Ranch

Create your dream racing estate. Use your winnings to upgrade your home and ranch with new features, decorations, and improvements that show off your success.

🎨 Customize Your Character & Horses

Express your style with customization options for both your rider and horses. Outfit your character, choose unique looks for your horses, and stand out at the track.

💰 Player Marketplace

Buy and sell horses with other players in the marketplace. Find hidden gems, trade valuable bloodlines, or sell your best racers to grow your fortune.

🏆 Become a Racing Legend

Breed elite horses, dominate online races, and build the most prestigious stable in Derby Champions.

The track is waiting.

Do you have what it takes to create the next champion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 2600 / Intel i5 6th gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 3gb
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WIndows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 5400 / Intel i7 8th gen
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 / AMD RX6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
